title: Example Tab
text:
Example Tab
To include a file in the website as a tab, the file should be created first, and then added in the _quarto.yml file, in website\navbar section.
for example:
website:
  title: "QuartoTestWebsite"
  navbar:
    left:
      - href: index.qmd
        text: Home
      - about.qmd
      - exampleTab.qmd

title: Demo of a Julia Notebook With a Random Simulation
text:
using Random, CairoMakie

rng = 1:5
nSim = 10

sim = rand(rng, nSim)

fig, ax, plt = barplot(
    1:nSim, sim
)
ax.title = "Picking $nSim Number With Replacement From 1 to 5"

fig

title: Demo of a Julia With No Freeze
text:
The content of this notebook will be re-executed each time the website is rendered. This is because, in the settings of this Quarto notebook, the freeze option is set to false.
title: "Demo of a Julia With No Freeze"
engine: julia
execute: 
    freeze: false 

using Random, CairoMakie

rng = 1:5
nSim = 10

sim = rand(rng, nSim)

fig, ax, plt = barplot(
    1:nSim, sim
)
ax.title = "Picking $nSim Number With Replacement From 1 to 5"

fig
